checks: Every MC answer was independently derived and all four choices were assigned explicit truth values.
Negative signs, ratios, angle statements, perpendicularity, midpoint conditions, and center definitions were reviewed.
Constructed-response rubrics were checked against the specific proof or calculation required.
No item requires coordinate geometry, formal symbolic logic, Euler-line theory, or other future/high-school content.
All figures were rendered on white background at 480x320 and inspected for clipping, readability, geometry markers, and answer leakage.

actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.issue: The first-draft introductory definition prompts for external center, internal center, centroid, and orthocenter used overly parallel sentence frames.
actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.repair: Rewrote the four prompts as distinct mathematical tasks: locating an external-circle center, selecting an incenter construction, locating a centroid on a board, and identifying the complete orthocenter definition.

actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.issue: Four lecture display titles contained the internal list separator `、`, which conflicts with the project title convention.
actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.repair: Rephrased the titles with `與`, `及`, or a non-list construction without changing any locked skill title or skill ID.

actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.issue: Two SVGs used Chinese inline labels that rendered as missing-glyph boxes in the available SVG renderer.
actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.repair: Replaced only those visual labels with `t` and `I/II/III`; the Traditional Chinese title, description, and alt text remain complete.

actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.issue: Initial semantic-review hash values were computed with an inconsistent self-hash exclusion rule.
actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.repair: Recomputed every semantic review SHA-256 canonically while excluding only `reviewSha256`, then regenerated the content hash manifest.

actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.issue: The first verifier draft imposed arbitrary minimum array lengths and expected a nonexistent constructed-response review key, causing valid dense solutions and concise option analyses to fail.
actualIssuesFoundAndRepaired.repair: Aligned validation with the actual schema: require completeness and nonempty specific evidence rather than artificial step counts, and validate `derivedResult` in constructed-response independent reviews.
